title: Žaġręn · R03 第二阶段：A/O类格尾分布诊断与现代证据核验方案
purpose: 现有A/O名词模板先按形态位置与方言取证，再建立受控句最小对立测试门槛。所有格尾分布来自历史校准的pilot，而不是现代真实语料。

evidencePolicy.knownCanonical: lexical headwords and defined core syntactic rules only
evidencePolicy.controlled: Only explicitly recorded sentence contexts A01/A02 and historical-reconciled A06/A14/A15/A16 are evidence for those contexts.
evidencePolicy.pilot: Morphology templates in V0.7 / R03 are candidate paradigms; uniformity is not a substitute for independent modern usage.
evidencePolicy.noNegativeProof: An absent za token in a pilot noun inflection cell does NOT imply that za is forbidden in a full noun phrase.
evidencePolicy.noNewGrammar: Class patterns and questions below do not certify new case endings or enlarge the M07 za rule.
